4.7.2.6 LinkTime
The latest Binding Time LinkTime will not be supported for VariationPoints relevant for
the RTE Generator.
[SWS_Rte_06511] ⌈The RTE generator shall reject configuration which defines RTE
or Basic Software Scheduler relevant LinkTime variability.⌋(SRS_Rte_00018)
